'''Belgrad''' is the capital of the [[Belcanto Nations]] and one of the main symbolic centers of Belcantese political identity.

== Pre-Conquest Role ==

Belgrad was associated with the pre-conquest [[United Kingdoms of Belcanto]] and the older federal traditions that connected the Belcantese regions.

== Vesperan Occupation ==

During the [[Belcanto Campaign]], Vesperan forces captured the capital after a prolonged siege in source material. Occupation authorities later used the city as the administrative center of the Belcanto governorship.

Source material also uses names such as Belcanto Centrale and New Vespera in relation to the capital. This draft preserves Belgrad as the stable AGGSWorld article title until the occupation-era naming is reviewed.

== Independence ==

The [[Declaration of Belcantese Independence]] was proclaimed in Belgrad on 15 May 1949. After independence, the city became the center of federal reconstruction, language restoration, and postwar government.
